claims.citation: New York Herald, 22 May 1866, p. 9, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Ship Deutschland (Ham), Hensen, Hamburg, 31 days, with
mdse and 507 passengers, to Kunhardt & Co. Two adults
and three children died. April 26, lat 50[?] 2[?], lon 2 22, spoke
ship Johanne Wilhelmine (Brem); 29th, lat 50[?] 45, lon 14, ship
Eugenie (Ham); May 4, lat 51 28, lon 32, ship Broderne
(Norw), from Bergen for Montreal, 8 days out; in lat 45 30,
lon 47 30, passed some icebergs.
